# Testoza

> **AI-powered online examination platform** that transforms how educators create, administer, and secure tests. Testoza combines intelligent test generation with strict proctoring security and institutional branding capabilities to deliver professional-grade assessments for schools, colleges, coaching institutes, and corporations.

## Core Features

- **AI-Powered Test Creation** – Generate comprehensive tests instantly from PDFs, images, text, and YouTube videos. Our AI analyzes content and creates relevant multiple-choice, multiple-select, fill-in-blank, and true/false questions with appropriate difficulty levels.

- **PDF-to-Test Generation** – Upload any PDF document (notes, textbooks, articles) and automatically convert it into a structured test with AI-generated questions. Support for scanned documents and handwritten notes.

- **Strict Proctoring Security** – Multi-layered anti-cheating system including:
  - Tab switching detection and prevention
  - Copy-paste blocking and right-click disable
  - Full-screen enforcement with exit warnings
  - Browser dev tools blocking (F12, Ctrl+Shift+I, Inspect Element)
  - Print screen and screenshot prevention
  - Browser console access blocking
  - Real-time monitoring of suspicious activities
  - Session termination on security violations

- **Institutional Branding** – Complete white-label capabilities:
  - Custom organization logos and colors
  - Branded test interfaces
  - Custom certificate generation with institute branding
  - Dedicated test portals
  - URL customization options

- **Multiple Question Types** – Support for MCQ, Multiple Select, Fill in the Blanks, and True/False questions with rich media support.

- **Detailed Analytics** – Comprehensive performance reports with time tracking, question-wise analysis, and comparison metrics.

- **Flexible Test Sharing** – Share tests via public links, private access codes, or email invitations with customizable access permissions.

## Guides

- [How to conduct an online exam, step by step](https://testoza.com/how-to-conduct-online-exam): the whole process as an exam controller runs it: decide the stakes and where candidates sit; build the paper (objective questions, marks and negative marks such as +4/−1, time per question from NEET, JEE Main, CUET and SSC patterns); choose how candidates get in (a private link, or a six-digit join code at testoza.com/join with name, roll number or roll number + PIN, no accounts); exam rules (full screen, app-switch detection with a warning limit, copy/paste off) and their honest limits; a dry run with three phones; running the day (lobby 30 minutes before, Start, live monitoring, extra time, dead phones and lost signal); results, re-tests and records; a checklist; mistakes to avoid; when Google Forms is enough
- [Moodle alternative for online tests and exams](https://testoza.com/moodle-alternative): when to keep Moodle (courses, assignments, forums, SCORM, a term gradebook) and when to move tests to an exam platform; self-hosted Moodle vs MoodleCloud (from ₹15,340 a year for 50 users, no plugins) vs TestoZa; what running Moodle 5.2 takes (PHP 8.3+, a database, cron every minute, support dates); candidates joining live exams at testoza.com/join with a six-digit code and a roll number, without accounts (Moodle guests cannot take quizzes); GIFT import vs AI extraction from PDFs and photos; negative marking in Moodle's fixed percentage list vs per-question marks; Safe Exam Browser (Windows, macOS, iOS only) vs browser exam rules on Android; switching, running both (no LTI), other Moodle alternatives and honest limits
- [The best online test platform for teachers, coaching institutes and students](https://testoza.com/best-online-test-platform): what an online test platform has to do (timers, negative marking, fair exams, phone support, useful results), where Google Forms, Microsoft Forms, Moodle and game-style quiz apps fall short, how coaching institutes run mocks on TestoZa, and how a student can turn photos of a textbook or old question paper into a timed practice test
- [CBT exam software](https://testoza.com/cbt-exam-software): what computer-based test (CBT) software must do for coaching institutes and schools: an NTA-style exam screen (question palette, Save & Next, review, on-screen keypad, optional scientific calculator), exact marking schemes for JEE Main, NEET, CUET, SSC CGL and GATE, running a CBT for a batch, computer lab vs phones, and honest limits
- [AI test generator](https://testoza.com/ai-test-generator): what an AI test generator does and how TestoZa's works: Extract (an existing paper's questions, options, diagrams and answer key, kept exactly; missing answers flagged, never guessed) vs Generate (new questions from a chapter or notes, usually 15 to 25 per run, at Easy, Moderate or Tough, in English, Hindi or both), the live processing and review screens, what it reads (maths, chemistry, passages, diagrams, Hindi), the two-minute review check, uses for teachers, coaching institutes and students, and honest limits (PDF and images only, a fair-use limit of 30 runs an hour)
- [JEE mock test platform](https://testoza.com/jee-mock-test-platform): how JEE faculty build JEE Main and JEE Advanced mocks without learning LaTeX: AI that writes LaTeX and mhchem from PDFs, Word files and photos, the Sy Pad on-screen maths and chemistry keyboard (where it is, how it works, tables, chemistry mode), JEE marking including JEE Advanced partial marks, what coaching institutes and self-studying aspirants get, and honest limits
- [NEET online test software](https://testoza.com/neet-online-test-software): what NEET online test software must do for coaching institutes and aspirants: the NEET-UG pattern (180 questions, 720 marks, +4/−1), the 2026 leak, re-exam and the proposed move to computer-based testing, statement, assertion–reason, match-list and diagram questions on screen (with a playable six-question mini-mock), building papers from NCERT pages with AI, running a test series with question-wise analysis, the +4/−1 guessing arithmetic, and honest limits (no OMR)
- [Create a mock test online](https://testoza.com/create-mock-test-online): turn a textbook photo, a PDF or an old question paper into a timed, exam-style mock test with negative marking and an NTA-style exam screen; for students, teachers and coaching institutes

## Free PDF tools (Panna)

Panna is TestoZa's free, in-browser PDF toolkit at https://pdf.testoza.com — files are processed on the user's device and never uploaded.

- [Edit PDF](https://pdf.testoza.com/edit-pdf): edit existing PDF text in the document's own font, erase for real, sign and annotate
- [Edit Hindi PDF](https://pdf.testoza.com/edit-hindi-pdf): edit Hindi (Devanagari) text with correct matras and conjuncts
- [LaTeX to PDF](https://pdf.testoza.com/latex-to-pdf): convert LaTeX or AI-generated maths into a PDF with selectable text
- [ChatGPT to PDF](https://pdf.testoza.com/chatgpt-to-pdf): save ChatGPT, Gemini or Claude answers as PDF with equations intact
- [The complete Panna guide](https://blog.testoza.com/stop-painting-white-boxes-on-your-pdfs): every tool, how same-font editing and true erasing work, Hindi support, and a comparison with Smallpdf, iLovePDF, Sejda, Adobe Acrobat and PDF24
- [Panna in the user guide](https://testoza.com/user-guide/pdf-tools): short how-to with links to each tool
